LightningComponentBundle.description: Help center entry point: gates on the first-login welcome video, then shows the article browser. Works in Experience Cloud and core app.

property.name: hideBranding
property.label: Hide Diversify Branding
property.description: The site supplies the brand chrome: hides the Diversify logo, brand crumb and brand footer, and collapses the header strip while no page control is slotted. Set on the /help site pages (the theme layout owns the header) and on embeddings that carry their own header/branding.
